templates.name: Pre-Arrival Information
templates.subject: Your stay is coming up — important arrival info
templates.body:
Hi {{guest_name}},

Your stay at {{property_name}} is just around the corner! Here's everything you need to know before you arrive.

Your Stay
───────────────────────────
Check-in:   {{check_in}} from 3:00 PM
Check-out:  {{check_out}} by 10:00 AM

Directions to Mt Baw Baw
───────────────────────────
From Melbourne, take the M1 Freeway towards Traralgon, then follow signs to Mt Baw Baw via Rawson. The resort is approximately 2.5 hours from Melbourne CBD.

In winter, snow chains may be required on the mountain road. Check road conditions at vicroads.vic.gov.au before you travel.

Parking
───────────────────────────
Undercover parking is available at the apartment. Your parking bay is clearly marked. Please do not park in other bays.

What to Bring
───────────────────────────
• Warm clothing and layers — it gets cold on the mountain!
• Snow gear (ski/snowboard equipment can be hired at the resort)
• Groceries — the nearest supermarket is in Moe or Drouin
• Bed linen and bath towels — NOT supplied (linen hire available: Q/D sets $40, Single sets $20 — contact us to arrange)
• Your own toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, body wash)

What's Already Provided
───────────────────────────
Doonas, blankets and pillows (all beds), full kitchen, tea/coffee, toilet paper, hand soap, hairdryers, 2 toboggans, gas log fireplace.

We're excited to have you — see you soon!

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team

templates.name: Check-in Instructions
templates.trigger: Sent on the morning of check-in
templates.subject: Check-in instructions for today — {{property_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{guest_name}},

Welcome to your ski getaway! Here are your check-in instructions for today.

Check-in: from 3:00 PM
Reference: {{booking_ref}}

Key Collection
───────────────────────────
Your key is held in the lockbox located at the main apartment entrance.

Lockbox code: [CODE WILL BE PROVIDED BY HOST]

Please collect your key on arrival. The lockbox is on the right-hand side of the front door.

Apartment Location
───────────────────────────
Cascade Apartment 4 is in the main Cascade Lodge building.
Follow signs to Cascade Lodge from the resort entry.
Take the lift or stairs to Level 1, turn left, Apartment 4 is at the end of the corridor.

Important Notes
───────────────────────────
• No smoking inside the apartment
• No parties or excessive noise after 10:00 PM
• Maximum {{guest_count}} guests as per your booking
• Pets are not permitted

Emergency contacts and resort info are displayed on the noticeboard inside the apartment.

Enjoy your stay!

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team

templates.name: Check-out Reminder
templates.trigger: Sent on the evening before check-out
templates.subject: Check-out reminder for tomorrow — {{property_name}}
templates.body:
Hi {{guest_name}},

Just a friendly reminder that your check-out is tomorrow, {{check_out}}, by 10:00 AM.

Check-out Checklist
───────────────────────────
✓  Return key to the lockbox and scramble the code
✓  Remove all food from the fridge and pantry
✓  Place used dishes in the dishwasher and start it
✓  If you hired linen or towels, place them in the laundry basket (no need to remake beds)
✓  Take all rubbish to the bin room at the end of the corridor
✓  Turn off all lights, heaters, and the fireplace
✓  Lock all windows and the front door behind you

Late Check-out
───────────────────────────
If you need a late check-out, please reply to this email as soon as possible. Late check-outs are subject to availability and may incur an additional fee.

We hope you've had a wonderful stay! It's been a pleasure hosting you.

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team

templates.name: Post-Stay Thank You
templates.subject: Thank you for staying at {{property_name}}!
templates.body:
Hi {{guest_name}},

Thank you so much for choosing Cascade Apartment 4 for your mountain escape. We hope you had a fantastic time on the mountain!

Your stay: {{check_in}} — {{check_out}}

We'd love to hear how your stay went. If you have a moment, a review on our listing would mean the world to us — it helps other guests discover us and helps us continue improving.

Come Back Soon
───────────────────────────
As a returning guest, you'll receive priority access to our best rates. To book your next stay, visit our website or reply to this email.

We hope to see you back on the mountain soon!

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team

templates.name: Review Request
templates.subject: How was your stay at {{property_name}}?
templates.body:
Hi {{guest_name}},

We hope you're settling back home after your stay at Cascade Apartment 4!

Your feedback means a great deal to us. If you have 2 minutes, we'd love it if you could leave a review of your recent stay ({{check_in}} — {{check_out}}).

Your honest review helps other travellers discover the apartment, and gives us valuable insight into how we can make each stay better.

If anything about your stay fell short of expectations, please do let us know by replying to this email — we'd love the chance to make it right.

Thank you again for staying with us, {{guest_name}}. It was a pleasure to host you.

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team

Hi {{guest_name}},

This email confirms that your booking at {{property_name}} has been cancelled.

Cancelled Booking
───────────────────────────
Reference:   {{booking_ref}}
Check-in:    {{check_in}}
Check-out:   {{check_out}}

Refund Information
───────────────────────────
Any applicable refund will be processed according to our cancellation policy and returned to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

If you did not request this cancellation or believe this is an error, please contact us immediately at hello@cascadeskiapartments.com.

We're sorry we won't be seeing you this time. We hope to welcome you to Cascade Apartment 4 in the future.

Warm regards,
The Cascade Apartment 4 Team
